name: reconcile-splice-equivalence-tests
body:
source: `spec-splice-guard/feedback-7` (final-review divergence) — the `solution.component.splice-equivalence-tests` body described the change-set addition and its implemented-by set named only the pre-existing code-only tests.

Inconsistency: a `SpecImplementedBy` query listed `merge_round_trip_start_mutate_verify_merge_rebuild`, `delta_application_matches_a_full_rebuild`, `seed_copy_preserves_every_table_and_row`, `spliced_and_full_rebuild_agree_on_every_table_count`, and `fixture_graph`; the tests delivering `requirements.requirement.spec-only-splice-equivalence-tests` had no claim reaching them.

Resolution: added `implemented-by` edges to `rust.project_cmd_e2e.e2e.merge_spec_only_lands_authored_rows_in_main_db`, `rust.splice_e2e.e2e.spec_only_delta_cannot_diverge_from_full_rebuild`, and `rust.splice_e2e.e2e.diverged_authored_rows_are_not_fast_pathed`, and rewrote the body in the present tense. [with user]
